chunks: From him, from Fudayla, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sayyaba, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Do I supplicate to Allah while I am prostrating?' He said, 'Yes, supplicate for this world and the Hereafter, for He is the Lord of this world and the Hereafter.'
ai.seo_question: Can I make du'a for worldly matters while prostrating in prayer?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) validates the permissibility of supplicating while in prostration (*sujud*), explicitly encouraging the inclusion of both worldly (*dunya*) and hereafter (*akhirah*) needs. This guidance underscores the Shia understanding of Allah’s comprehensive lordship over all realms, reinforcing the holistic nature of worship where spiritual and material blessings are sought simultaneously from the same Divine Source.
